whenToUse: You change the measure of the same data, such as daily, weekly, or monthly.
You switch the display, such as list view or card view.
There are two to five options with short labels.
whenNotToUse: There are many options or long labels (consider a dropdown).
It moves to an entirely different content area.
People need to choose several at once.
accessibility: Use native radio inputs so the browser handles arrow-key movement and selection.
Name the group with <fieldset> and <legend> (it can be visually hidden).
The selected state changes background, shadow, and weight together, not color alone.
Draw the focus ring on the visible label with peer-focus-visible instead of on the hidden input.
